scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The proof establishes \(\operatorname{sat}_{<}(n,A)=O(1)\) from the published witness theorem and proves \(\operatorname{sat}_{<}(n,\{A,B\})\ge(n-1)/4\) by an infinite counting argument. No exact pair value or matching upper bound is claimed. Self-review only; independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: A counterexample for saturation with multiple forbidden ordered graphs
